Unlock Conditions: Discover Acropolis of Atlantis; after that, accept a Ancient Technology Research Imperial Quest from Store Keeper (requires 100 of one type of trade goods per quest) and earn 50/600 ATR points.

How to activate: Use Crystal of Blessing and select this blessing.

Effect: For 30 minutes, a bonus will be applied to Ancient Technology Research points earned for performing actions related to an ATR Imperial Quest. The amount of bonus points received is related to its current rank.

Rank 1 (0-19 Crystals used): an additional +1 to every ATR point earned
Rank 2 (20-39 Crystals used): an additional +2 to every ATR points earned
Rank 3 (40+ Crystals used): an additional +3 to every ATR points earned
